svg.title: Eidetic Studio — Build Order
svg.text: EIDETIC STUDIO — BUILD ORDER (FROM SCRATCH)
Work top to bottom. Power OFF before wiring audio. Assumes nothing is yet connected — patchbay and Octatrack on the bench.
SESSION 0 — GATHER — confirm you have everything
Samson S-Patch Plus + rack screws · Octatrack MKII + PSU · CompactFlash 8–16 GB (not over 32 GB)
Powered USB hub (OWC/Anker 10-port) · ~30 long balanced TRS for rear wiring · 4–6 short TRS patch (30 cm)
3× DIN MIDI · 1× ¼″ TS (kick) · 1× 3.5 mm mini → 2× ¼″ breakout (TB-03 — Boutique output is 3.5 mm, use L)
2× XLR(F)→TRS (Soundcraft Main Mix → PreSonus line ins) · vocal mic kit if missing · label tape
SESSION 1 — MAC AND SOFTWARE
Update macOS · install/update Ableton Live 12 Suite · install PreSonus Universal Control (UC Surface) + restart
Install Elektron Transfer · Valhalla Supermassive (free, for the rumble reverb)
Create ~/Music/Eidetic Samples/ { Vocals-Raw, Vocals-Processed, Digitakt-Pending, Digitakt-OnDevice, Octatrack-CF }
Set Ableton to 48 kHz / 24-bit · save a default template (inputs 1–2 + 3–4 enabled, buffer 128)
SESSION 2 — MOUNT AND LABEL THE PATCHBAY
POWER OFF ALL GEAR before touching the patchbay rear.
Mount the S-Patch Plus in the Zaor rack — check rear clearance for cable bend radius.
Set all columns to HALF-NORMAL (front-panel switches). Label front + rear, columns 1–24.
PHOTOGRAPH the labelled bay before any cables go in — you'll thank yourself later.
SESSION 3 — WIRE AUDIO — SOURCES TO REAR-TOP
TR-8S Assign 1 (KICK, TS) → rear-top 1 · TB-03 (3.5 mm breakout, L leg) → rear-top 2
TR-8S Main L/R → rear-top 3–4 · Digitakt Out L/R → rear-top 5–6
Octatrack Main L/R → rear-top 9–10 · Octatrack Cue L/R → rear-top 13–14
Soundcraft GRP 1/2 outs → rear-top 11–12 · Soundcraft Aux 1/2 outs → rear-top 15–16
Leave rear-top 7–8 EMPTY (future synth) · 17–18 EMPTY (front-patch flex) · 19–24 future
SESSION 4 — WIRE AUDIO — REAR-BOTTOM TO MIXER / INTERFACE / SAMPLERS
Half-normal means rear-top already feeds rear-bottom internally. Now cable the bottom row outward:
Rear-bottom 1–6 → Soundcraft Ch 1–6 · leave rear-bottom 7–8 UNWIRED — no synth = no cables
Rear-bottom 9–10 → Soundcraft ST 9/10 · rear-bottom 11–12 → Digitakt In L/R (= RESAMPLE BUS)
Rear-bottom 13–14 → PreSonus In 3–4 · rear-bottom 15–16 → Octatrack In A/B (= OT SEND BUS)
Leave rear-bottom 17–18 UNWIRED (reserved: OT In C/D — wire on concrete need) · 19–24 future
▲ Soundcraft 11/12 is the RCA-only playback channel — nothing from the patchbay goes there.
SESSION 5 — WIRE THE DIRECT (NON-PATCHBAY) LINKS
Soundcraft Main Mix L/R (XLR outs) → PreSonus In 7–8 (rear line ins) — XLR→TRS · NOT In 1–2 (front preamps)
PreSonus Main Out → BM9S SAT/SUB IN → SAT OUT (HP 80 Hz) → HS8s · USB-C → Mac DIRECTLY, never via hub.
Phone / Mac line out → Soundcraft RCA 11/12 for reference tracks (INTERVAL MUTE = instant A/B)
Soundcraft USB: leave UNPLUGGED.
SESSION 6 — WIRE MIDI (DIN CHAIN)
Octatrack MIDI OUT → Digitakt MIDI IN
Digitakt MIDI THRU → TR-8S MIDI IN
TR-8S MIDI OUT → TB-03 MIDI IN (TR-8S has no Thru jack — enable UTILITY > MIDI > Soft Thru: ON)
MiniLab 3: USB to the hub only. Not in this chain.
SESSION 7 — WIRE USB (via the powered hub)
Hub → Mac (one cable). Then into the hub: Digitakt, TR-8S, Octatrack (CF transfer), MiniLab 3.
Confirm PreSonus is still the ONLY thing on the Mac's direct USB-C — not the hub.
Insert the formatted CompactFlash card into the Octatrack.
SESSION 8 — SET CLOCK AND TEST
Octatrack: Clock Send ON, Transport Send ON. Digitakt/TR-8S/TB-03: receive/external sync ON.
Hit play on the Octatrack — all four devices should start together. Watch for any device drifting.
In Ableton: select PreSonus as the audio device, arm inputs 7–8 and 3–4, record a test loop.
If timing is solid, you're done. If you see real drift, only THEN look at a MIDI Thru box / Nome II.
SESSION 9 — FIRST SOUND — VALIDATE THE TWO BUSES
TR-8S performance kit: KICK → Assign 1. It leaves the Main Mix and appears alone on Soundcraft Ch 1.
Drive Ch 1 gain until the dbx limiter LED flickers — that's the analogue punch. Same trick on Ch 2 (TB-03).
SEND BUS: turn up Aux 1 on Ch 1 → OT In A · Thru machine → dark delay/reverb · low-pass ~150 Hz · resample to Flex.
Blend dry kick (Ch 1) against the resampled rumble (OT on ST 9/10). That's the genre's low end.
RESAMPLE BUS: press 1-2 (GRP) on Ch 1 + 5–6, hit sample on the Digitakt — groove captured, zero cables.
▲ Keep Aux 1/2 + GRP off on channel 9/10 (the OT itself) or you build a feedback loop.
SHOPPING SHORTLIST
~30 long balanced TRS · 6 short TRS patch (30 cm) · 3 DIN MIDI · 1 TS (kick) · 1× 3.5 mm→2×¼″ breakout (TB-03) · 2× XLR→TRS (main mix) · powered USB hub · CF 8–16 GB · vocal mic kit if missing.
Eidetic Studio · v8 · July 2026 · sheet 4/4 — Build Order
